defect: The condition for opening an encrypted key was reduced to 'decrypt' only, dropping the case where the public parts are empty, so encrypted ASN.1 keys without a public key are never decrypted and cannot be removed from the agent.
reason: The fix restores exactly the clause this change deleted (now via publicKey()), so the regression lies in the changed line.

defect: The new UrlTools guards getBaseDomainFromUrl and friends with WITH_XC_NETWORKING only, although BrowserService calls them, so a build with browser integration but without networking fails.
reason: The ifdefs were written in this new file and the fix widens them to include WITH_XC_BROWSER; the caller in BrowserService is needed to see it.

defect: The clipboard timeout read from the config is in seconds but is passed to QTimer::start as milliseconds, so the clipboard is cleared after 10 ms instead of 10 s.
reason: This change introduced reading the timeout from config; the default of 10 in Config.cpp and the seconds spin box show the unit mismatch the fix multiplies away.

defect: The byte is read into a plain char, which is signed on common platforms, so every byte >= 0x80 compares < 0x20 and all multi-byte UTF-8 characters are stripped.
reason: The loop is new in this file and the fix only changes the type to quint8.

defect: Replacing the per-iteration local TextStream (flushed on destruction) with the persistent Utils::STDERR stream and terminating with plain newline leaves the 'Unknown command' message unflushed.
reason: The endl part of the fix repairs output broken by this change's stream switch; the heap-use-after-free part concerns pre-existing currentDatabase handling, but the message defect is in the changed line.

defect: The uncolored password is HTML-escaped and then set with setPlainText, so characters like & or < are shown as entities; the font is also set after the content instead of before.
reason: Both the escaping and the font placement were written in this change and the fix corrects them directly.

defect: focusNextPrevChild dereferences qApp->focusWidget() without a null check, crashing when the application has no focused widget (e.g. unfocused during a save).
reason: The do-while loop over focusWidget()->parentWidget() is new in this change and the fix adds the missing null check.

defect: The new yubiKeySlot parameter is only used inside #ifdef WITH_XC_YUBIKEY, so builds without YubiKey get an unused-parameter warning, which is an error in Debug builds (-Werror).
reason: The parameter and its guarded use were added by this change; the fix adds Q_UNUSED in the #else branch.

defect: The DACL size adds GetLengthSid of the new owner-rights SID but no sizeof(ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE) for its ACE, so the ACL is too small for three ACEs when the SSH agent ACE is also added.
reason: The size expression was changed in this commit together with the new ACE, and the fix adds the missing ACE header size.

defect: The dialog connects to a non-existent signal lockedDatabase() instead of DatabaseWidget::databaseLocked(), so the TOTP dialog never closes on lock.
reason: The connect line is new in this change; DatabaseWidget.h shows the real signal name the fix uses.

defect: CGEventFlags variables are initialized from int literals and Carbon modifier constants, which does not compile with SDKs (OS X El Capitan) where CGEventFlags is an enum type.
reason: The CGEventFlags code was introduced here and the fix only adds explicit CGEventFlags conversions; seeing it requires the SDK's type definition.

defect: QByteArray('\x7E', 32) calls QByteArray(int size, char ch) with swapped arguments, creating a 126-byte array of spaces for the key and a 75-byte seed instead of 32 bytes, so the benchmark runs with a wrong key and seed.
reason: The benchmark thread is new in this change and the fix swaps the arguments to QByteArray(16, ...) and (32, ...).

defect: The new keyPressEvent swallows Enter/Return without passing it to QTreeView, so the activated() signal is no longer emitted and AutoTypeSelectDialog, which relies on it, stops reacting to Return.
reason: The keyPressEvent override was added here and the fix forwards the event to the base class; the dependency is in AutoTypeSelectDialog.

defect: The rewritten IfDevice loop sets loadDb to false for every listed device that does not match, so with several positive device names the result depends on the last one and a matching machine may not open the database.
reason: The else branch forcing false was added in this change and the fix removes it while restructuring the exclusion logic.

defect: writeAttachments writes every attachment of every entry (including history duplicates) to the inner header, while the XML writer references binaries by deduplicated index, so attachment references point at the wrong binaries.
reason: The new writeAttachments loop is the source of the duplicates and the fix deduplicates it; the dedup map in KdbxXmlWriter is needed to see the mismatch.

defect: QStandardPaths::writableLocation is called with QDesktopServices::AppDataLocation, which does not exist (and QDesktopServices is no longer included), so the non-X11 branch fails to compile on Mac and Windows.
reason: The faulty line was written in this change and the fix replaces the enum with QStandardPaths::AppDataLocation.

defect: On Windows the new Use Virtual Keyboard action is inserted at index 3 of the menu, shifting the copy actions, so updateActionMenu's index-based enabling disables or enables the wrong actions.
reason: The inserted action comes from this change while updateActionMenu (shown in the diff) still uses fixed indexes; the fix switches to property-based enabling and moves the insertion.

defect: The product-ID CFNumber is created from &vendorId instead of &productId, so device matching filters on the wrong product ID.
reason: Copy-paste typo in this new file, repaired one-for-one by the fix.

defect: isValidUuid rejects UUIDs whose version is VerUnknown, but KeePassXC entry UUIDs are random bytes without RFC 4122 version bits, so valid entry UUIDs are rejected and browser integration breaks.
reason: The version check is in the newly added function and the fix removes it; knowing how entry UUIDs are generated needs other code.

defect: The X11 headers are guarded by WITH_XC_AUTOTYPE while their uses are guarded by WITH_XC_X11, which is not defined in any included header, so all X11 functionality (global shortcuts, caps-lock detection) is silently compiled out.
reason: The inconsistent guards were added here; the fix switches the include guard to WITH_XC_X11, includes config-keepassx.h and defines the macro.

defect: A raw QWidget* from qApp->focusWidget() is kept across processEvents() and the save, and setFocus() is called on it afterwards even if the widget was deleted meanwhile, causing a use-after-free crash.
reason: The focus-restore code was added in this change and the fix replaces the raw pointer by QPointer.

defect: Every WM_POWERBROADCAST message's lParam is treated as a POWERBROADCAST_SETTING pointer without checking wParam == PBT_POWERSETTINGCHANGE, so other power events (e.g. suspend, lParam 0) dereference a null pointer.
reason: The handler is in this new file and the fix adds the wParam check and a null check.

defect: The lock file path is now built from canonicalPath() before the target file exists, which returns an empty string for a new file, so the lock file is created at the wrong location.
reason: Previously the lock path was computed after the save had created the file; this change moved it before writing, and the fix uses absolutePath() for non-existing files.

defect: The KEEPASSXC_MAIN_WINDOW macro dereferences qobject_cast<Application*>(qApp) without a null check, crashing when qApp is a plain QApplication such as in unit tests.
reason: The macro is new in this change and the fix adds the null guard.

defect: The fix only renames the inner loop variable that shadows the outer i; the shadowing inner declaration is legal C++ and behaves correctly.
reason: An inner 'int i' in a nested for loop is a distinct variable, so the original code repeated the resolved text correctly and the fix is a readability change.

defect: The excluded-characters field is passed to setCustomCharacterSet, overwriting the additional characters and adding the characters that should be excluded.
reason: The wrong setter call was written in this change and the fix replaces it with setExcludedCharacterSet.

defect: With best-match-only enabled, handleURL now accepts an entry only if host and path match exactly or the entry path is a longer prefix, so plain-domain entries (no path) or subdomain matches are filtered out and no credentials are returned.
reason: The bestMatchOnly gating in handleURL was added by this change and the later fix removes it while moving best-match to sort priority.

defect: With AutoSaveAfterEveryChange enabled, every database modification clears the LastDatabases setting, wiping the recent-databases list.
reason: The clearing block was added in this change and the fix deletes it.

defect: On non-Windows systems the file dialog filter '*.*' only shows files containing a dot, hiding typical extensionless executables so the proxy binary cannot be selected.
reason: The filter is in the newly added showProxyLocationFileDialog and the fix changes it to '*'.

defect: autoTypeSequences no longer stops after the first match, so title and URL matches can append the same effective sequence several times, producing duplicate matches in the global auto-type selection.
reason: The list-building logic without deduplication was introduced here and the fix deduplicates the list with toSet().

defect: The generator's closed handler always sends the error message to the extension, even after a password was generated and applied, so the extension gets an error reply after a successful generation.
reason: The unconditional send is in the newly added showPasswordGenerator and the fix sends it only when no password was generated; seeing it needs the widget's signal order.

defect: The QTemporaryFile template is the plain filename without XXXXXX, so Qt appends the random part after the extension and the opened temp file loses its suffix, so the right application is not chosen.
reason: The template was written in this change and the fix prefixes XXXXXX. so the original suffix is preserved.

defect: The tab name uses QString('%1 [%2]').arg(name().arg(filename)) with a misplaced parenthesis, so %2 is never filled and the tab shows a literal '[%2]'.
reason: updateTabName is in this new file and the fix replaces the broken arg chaining.

defect: m_shareLabel is declared only under WITH_XC_KEESHARE but DatabaseWidget.cpp (same commit) uses it unguarded in search mode, so builds without KeeShare fail to compile.
reason: This change added both the guarded member and the unguarded use; the fix removes the header guard, and the use is in the .cpp file.

defect: resetComponentEditWidget now creates a new edit widget whenever componentWidgetLayout->isEmpty(), which is also true when the existing widget is merely hidden, so a second password field is added on show.
reason: The isEmpty() condition and the showEvent trigger were added here; the fix tracks the widget in a member instead, and seeing it needs QLayout::isEmpty's semantics.

defect: The Hide toolbar setting is applied only once in the constructor, so changing it in the settings has no effect until restart.
reason: This change wired the setting only at startup and the fix moves it to applySettingsChanges, which runs on settings changes.

defect: QUrl::port() returns -1 when no port is given, which stored in quint16 becomes 65535, so the Host header always carries port 65535.
reason: prepareHeadersToWrite is in this new file and the fix handles the -1 case and omits the port.

defect: saveEntry calls setExpires and setExpiryTime on entry->timeInfo(), which returns a TimeInfo by value, so the expiry changes are applied to a temporary and lost.
reason: These save lines were added here and the fix uses Entry setters; Entry.h shows timeInfo() returns a copy.

defect: The argument loop starts at index 0, so the program's own executable path (which exists as a file) is taken as the database filename.
reason: The parsing loop is new in this change and the fix starts it at index 1.

defect: handleURL now matches when the entry host ends with the site's base domain, so any entry on the same base domain matches regardless of subdomain (e.g. a.example.com credentials offered on b.example.com).
reason: The baseDomain call and the reversed endsWith check were introduced here, and the fix compares the site host against the entry host instead.
